properties.description: Top-level medallion orchestrator for a full (cold-start) initial load. Runs pl_bronze_initial_load, waits for it to finish, then runs pl_silver_initial_load. Both child pipelines live in the bronze workspace alongside this one (silver-promotion notebooks live in the silver workspace; only the pipelines move here). A pl_gold_initial_load stage will be added as a third ExecutePipeline activity once the gold layer is built.

activities.name: Bronze initial load
activities.description: Runs pl_bronze_initial_load (weather backfill today, additional bronze ingest siblings later). waitOnCompletion=true so silver doesn't start until bronze data is fully landed.

activities.name: Silver initial load
activities.description: Runs pl_silver_initial_load (also in bronze workspace), which fans out the three silver_curated_* notebooks living in the silver workspace.
